hours_late.fri: Open 24 hours (Uber Eats listing for this store shows 24 hours; chain site says '23 hours, 59 minutes, 7 days a week')
hours_late.confidence: medium: no store-specific hours on georgewebb.com; Uber Eats store page lists 24 hours; location confirmed operating August 2025. Call (or check Google) before relying on it at 3 AM.

places.vibe: Old-school Milwaukee counter diner with coffee cups, griddle smoke and a gruff-but-kind server.
places.why_go: It's the only true all-nighter in walking distance, and it's basically a Milwaukee rite of passage.
places.reviews_summary: A local institution loved for cheap, fast, small griddle burgers and all-night coffee rather than for culinary heights. A 2017 Milwaukee Magazine roundup was underwhelmed by the food, while a 2016 Milwaukee Record visit found it busy after midnight and pleasantly no-frills. It can get packed right after bar close (2 to 2:30 AM); in 2020 Milwaukee Record found the inner door locked during a 2:40 AM rush.
places.rating_notes: Uber Eats: 4.0 from 2,000+ delivery ratings (store page). Google/Yelp ratings for this specific store not verified.

places.name: Real Chili (Downtown)

hours_late.sun: CLOSED Sunday (downtown location). The Marquette location at 1625 W Wells St is open Sunday but only until 10 PM.
hours_late.confidence: high for Fri/Sat (official site and a July 2026 Urban Milwaukee review both say 3 AM); Sunday closure per official site, and the July 2026 review lists no Sunday hours.

places.serves_alcohol_note: No source mentions beer or liquor; it reads as a counter-service chili parlor (soda and chili). Treat as food only.
what_to_order: The Marquette: medium chili over spaghetti with beans
places.vibe: Barebones 1931-born chili counter with checkered floors, red stools, communal tables and old clippings on the walls.
places.why_go: A steaming bowl of Milwaukee history six minutes from bed, and it's the city's classic bar-close tradition.
places.reviews_summary: Reviewers and local critics call it a neighborhood gem: thick, rich, meat-based secret-recipe chili, fast counter service and warm staff who greet you like family. A July 2026 Urban Milwaukee review praised it as the real deal; Milwaukee Record calls it great comfort food and a post-bar-time staple.
places.rating_notes: Numeric Google/Yelp ratings not verified (Yelp blocks fetches). Critic coverage is consistently positive, most recently July 2026.

notes: Hotel coordinates used for walk times: Drury Plaza, 700 N Water St (43.03864, -87.90905, US Census geocoder); Riverside Theater, 116 W Wisconsin Ave (43.03876, -87.91083). Walk times are estimates from straight-line grid distance at about 3 mph, not routed. Bottom line: Milwaukee has almost no true 24-hour diners left. The downtown George Webb is the only one within walking distance and appears to run around the clock. The classic 24-hour Greek family restaurants are gone or have cut back: Ma Fischer's (East Side) now lists 7 AM to 9 PM, Zebb's reopened with 8 AM to 10 PM hours, the East Side George Webb on Oakland closed in February 2025, and Omega on S. 27th St (once 24 hours) is slated for demolition (Urban Milwaukee, August 2026). Sunday is the tricky night: Real Chili downtown is closed, so Sunday after the show it's George Webb (food, no booze) or the Brat House (beer plus food until about 1 AM). Wisconsin bar close is 2 AM weeknights and 2:30 AM Fri/Sat, so expect George Webb and Real Chili to get a rush right after. Also considered but not picked: Uppa Yard on Water (1123 N Water St, Jamaican jerk and live music, open until 2 AM Fri/Sat, 10 PM Sun) opened in August 2026, too new to have a review track record and kitchen close time unverified; Gyro Palace in Walker's Point (602 S 2nd St, about a 25-minute walk or 5-minute drive) shows online ordering until 2:25 AM, but its dine-in hours weren't verified.
